Translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Beneficent, the Most Merciful

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
Translation: O Allah, bless Muhammad and the family of Muhammad

Arabic text: يَا مَنْ تُحَلُّ بِهِ عُقَدُ الْمَكَارِهِ
Translation: O You who unties the knots of difficulties

Arabic text: وَيَا مَنْ يُفْثَأُ بِهِ حَدُّ الشَّدَائِدِ
Translation: And O You who alleviates the severity of hardships

Arabic text: وَيَا مَنْ يُلْتَمَسُ مِنْهُ الْمَخْرَجُ إِلَى رَوْحِ الْفَرَجِ
Translation: And O You from whom relief and comfort are sought
Difficulties are humbled by Your power
And means are facilitated by Your kindness
And decrees flow by Your power
And things proceed according to Your will
They comply with Your intention without Your verbal command
And are restrained by Your will without Your verbal prohibition
You are the One called upon for important matters
And You are the refuge in calamities

Arabic text: لَا يَنْدَفِعُ مِنْهَا إِلَّا مَا دَفَعْتَ
Translation: Nothing can be repelled except what You repel

Arabic text: وَلَا يَنْكَشِفُ مِنْهَا إِلَّا مَا كَشَفْتَ
Translation: And nothing can be removed except what You remove

Arabic text: وَقَدْ نَزَلَ بِيْ يَا رَبِّ مَا قَدْ تَكَأَّدَنِيْ ثِقْلُهُ
Translation: O Lord, I have been afflicted with a burden that weighs heavily upon me

Arabic text: وَأَلَمَّ بِيْ مَا قَدْ بَهَظَنِيْ حَمْلُهُ
Translation: And I am overwhelmed by what has befallen me
By Your power, You have brought it upon me
And by Your authority, You have directed it towards me
None can ward off what You bring
And none can divert what You direct
None can open what You have closed
And none can close what You have opened
None can ease what You have made difficult
And none can help whom You have abandoned
So send blessings upon Muhammad and his family

Arabic text: وَافْتَحْ لِيْ يَا رَبِّ بَابَ الْفَرَجِ بِطَوْلِكَ
Translation: And open for me, O Lord, the door of relief by Your generosity
And break the authority of sorrow over me by Your might
And grant me the best outcome in what I have complained about
And let me taste the sweetness of Your help in what I have asked for

Arabic text: وَهَبْ لِيْ مِنْ لَدُنْكَ رَحْمَةً وَفَرَجًا هَنِيئًا
Translation: And grant me from Yourself mercy and pleasant relief

Arabic text: وَاجْعَلْ لِيْ مِنْ عِنْدِكَ مَخْرَجًا وَحِيًّا
Translation: And provide for me a swift way out from Your presence

Arabic text: وَلَا تَشْغَلْنِيْ بِالْإِهْتِمَامِ عَنْ تَعَاهُدِ فُرُوضِكَ وَاسْتِعْمَالِ سُنَّتِكَ
Translation: And do not distract me with worries from observing Your obligations and practicing Your traditions

Arabic text: فَقَدْ ضِقْتُ لِمَا نَزَلَ بِيْ يَا رَبِّ ذَرْعًا
Translation: For I have become too constricted, O Lord, by what has befallen me

Arabic text: وَامْتَلَأْتُ بِحَمْلِ مَا حَدَثَ عَلَيَّ هَمًّا
Translation: And I am filled with anxiety by the burden of what has happened to me

Arabic text: وَأَنْتَ الْقَادِرُ عَلَى كَشْفِ مَا مُنِيتُ بِهِ
Translation: You have the power to remove what has afflicted me
And to repel what I have fallen into

Arabic text: فَافْعَلْ بِيْ ذٰلِكَ وَإِنْ لَمْ أَسْتَوْجِبْهُ مِنْكَ
Translation: So do this for me even if I do not deserve it from You
O Lord of the Mighty Throne
